# Bevel UI

> Fully-engineered UI systems for React. Copy the source into your project and own it forever. shadcn/ui compatible. No npm package. No lock-in.

Bevel UI ships complete, production-ready UI systems — not component primitives. Each system solves a hard UI engineering problem end-to-end: state machine, edge cases, keyboard navigation, accessibility, validation. You install it once with the shadcn CLI and it lives in your codebase forever.

Install any system:
npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/<system-name>.json

Built on: React 18+/19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/introduction): What Bevel UI is and how it differs from a component library
- [Installation](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/installation): How to install any system with the shadcn CLI
- [All Systems](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components): Browse all 15 available systems

## Systems Documentation

### Navigation & Search

- [Product Tour](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/product-tour): Guided tour system with SVG overlay masking, viewport-aware floating cards, media support, keyboard navigation, step skip/resume. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/tour.json
- [Command Palette](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/command-palette): ⌘K command menu with fuzzy search, two-tier tab filtering, grouped results, avatar support. Zero external deps. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/command-palette.json
- [Spotlight Search](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/spotlight): Async content search with category tabs, recent history, rich result cards. Triggered by /. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/spotlight.json

### Forms & Input

- [Form Engine](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/form-engine): Multi-step form orchestration. Config-driven or headless modes. Plugin system (Zod, analytics, server validation). react-hook-form + zod. Per-step validation. Conditional fields. Custom layouts. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/form-engine.json
- [File Upload](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/file-upload): Drag-and-drop file upload with per-file progress, cancel, retry, grid/list views, modal mode. Bring your own upload function. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/file-upload.json

### Drag & Drop

- [Sortable](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/sortable): Headless drag-to-reorder for any list. useSortableList hook manages the array. Handle mode, drag overlay. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/sortable.json
- [Kanban](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/kanban): Multi-container drag-and-drop board. Drag cards between columns, reorder columns. Virtual state machine with live placeholders. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/kanban.json

### Layout & Panels

- [Properties Panel](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/properties-panel): Figma-style properties panel with collapsible sections, typed control rows, data-driven or headless API. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/properties-panel.json
- [Resizable Panels](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/resizable): Split-pane layouts with smooth drag-to-resize, min/max constraints, collapsible panels. Zero re-renders during drag. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/resizable.json
- [Tree View](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/tree): Recursive hierarchical data with expand/collapse, multi-select, keyboard navigation, optional connecting lines. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/tree.json

### Media & Color

- [Media Gallery](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/gallery): Selectable media grid for images, video, audio, documents. Multi-select, type filtering, keyboard lightbox, drag-to-reorder. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/gallery.json
- [Image Cropper](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/cropper): Eight-handle crop with aspect ratio enforcement, rule-of-thirds overlay, offscreen canvas export at full resolution. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/cropper.json
- [Palette Editor](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/palette): Visual color palette editor with 2D HSV picker, sortable swatches, export to hex/CSS vars/Tailwind/HSL. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/palette.json

### Collaboration

- [Collaborative Cursors](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/cursors): Real-time presence overlay with position sync, idle detection, label overlap resolver. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/cursors.json
- [Onboarding Checklist](https://bevelui.vercel.app/docs/components/checklist): Floating checklist widget with step dependencies, localStorage persistence, animated expand/collapse. Install: npx shadcn@latest add https://bevelui.vercel.app/r/checklist.json

## Bevel Labs

Six fully functional demo applications built with Bevel systems:
- Vault (Google Drive-style file manager using File Upload + Command Palette)
- Onboard (SaaS signup flow using Form Engine + Product Tour)
- Launchpad (developer deployment dashboard using Command Palette + Product Tour)
- Intake (job application form using Form Engine)
- Briefcase (client project handoff using Form Engine + File Upload)
- Compass (settings hub with 5 sections, navigable via sidebar and ⌘K)

Labs source code is available with the Pro license.

## Pricing

- Free: MIT licensed. Includes Product Tour, Command Palette, File Upload, Form Engine, Sortable, Kanban, Tree View, Gallery, Palette Editor, Properties Panel, Resizable, Spotlight, Checklist.
- Pro: $49 one-time payment. All systems + Image Cropper, Collaborative Cursors + Bevel Labs source.

## Key Facts

- Based on: shadcn/ui (same primitives, drops into existing setup)
- No npm package to manage — source lives in your project
- Works with any backend, any data-fetching library
- React 18+ and React 19 compatible
